state.title: Python input aborts the CLI
state.body: Summary: Hoonarqube crashes while analyzing a Python fixture. Classification: Bug. Version: Hoonarqube 0.10.4 commit 1b08eba7832f32c6ed5233e51d725092c6e8de77, Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12. Reproduction: file sample.py contains print(42); run hoonarqube analyze sample.py --format json. Expected: a JSON report and exit 0. Actual: panic and exit 101. Evidence: complete stderr says index out of bounds; empty.py with no contents returns a report and exit 0 using the same binary. Acceptance: this input returns a valid report and exit 0; preserve the empty-file control. Impact: this blocks all of our Python analyses and we have no workaround.

state.title: C# analyzer incorrectly flags a safe SQL example
state.body: Classification: Bug. Hoonarqube 0.10.4 commit 1b08eba7832f32c6ed5233e51d725092c6e8de77 on Ubuntu 24.04 and .NET 10 flags C# parameterized SQL as vulnerable in a synthetic analyzer fixture. This is a claimed false positive in the analyzer rule, not a vulnerability in Hoonarqube. Reproduction: run hoonarqube analyze safe.cs --format json. The fixture uses SqlCommand with a bound parameter. Expected no SQL injection finding; actual one finding with exit 0. Evidence: complete JSON includes the SQL rule on safe.cs; unsafe.cs concatenating untrusted input yields a finding as expected. Acceptance: preserve the unsafe control while suppressing the clean fixture finding. No user impact level is established.
